projects.description: An interactive sales and customer report built with Excel and Power BI to analyze revenue, profit, orders, payment methods, sales channels, delivery status, and geographic performance.
lines: # Sales & Customer Analytics Dashboard
### An interactive sales and customer report built with Excel and Power BI to analyze revenue, profit, orders, payment methods, sales channels, delivery status, and geographic performance.
Prepared and structured source data in Excel, then used Power Query, data
modeling, and DAX in Power BI. The report includes KPI cards and interactive
visuals for products, order status, payment methods, sales channels,
sub-categories, profit by category, and state-wise sales. The repository
documents that the dataset is synthetic/sample data.
Built with Power BI · Excel · Power Query · DAX · Data Modeling
[Visit](https://github.com/devanshudwivedi619/Sales-Customer-Analytics-Dashboard)

projects.description: A dashboard exploring IT spend, software license usage, unused licenses, vendor costs, department budgets, and contract renewal status.
lines: # IT Spend & Asset Utilization Dashboard
### A dashboard exploring IT spend, software license usage, unused licenses, vendor costs, department budgets, and contract renewal status.
The repository describes a 300-record sample dataset and reports ₹5.51 crore
in total IT spend, 9,025 purchased licenses, 69.42% utilization, and 2,778
unused licenses. Built using Power BI, DAX, and Power Query. Figures are
from the sample project dataset, not a real company engagement.
Built with Power BI · DAX · Power Query · Data Visualization
[Visit](https://github.com/devanshudwivedi619/IT-Spend-Asset-Utilization-PowerBI-Dashboard)

projects.description: An interactive analysis of retail orders, sales, profit, customer segments, product categories, order priority, and regional performance.
lines: # Superstore Sales & Profit Insights
### An interactive analysis of retail orders, sales, profit, customer segments, product categories, order priority, and regional performance.
The project README describes analysis of 9,426 orders from 2010–2013, with
reported totals of $8.95M sales and $1.31M profit. It includes KPI cards,
sales and profit trends, category profitability, customer segment analysis,
order priority, geographic visuals, and interactive filters.
Built with Power BI · Excel · Power Query · DAX
[Visit](https://github.com/devanshudwivedi619/Superstore-Sales-Profit-Insights-Dashboard-)

projects.description: An exploratory analysis of hotel booking patterns, cancellations, seasonal arrivals, pricing, market segments, and guest behavior.
lines: # Hotel Booking Demand Analysis
### An exploratory analysis of hotel booking patterns, cancellations, seasonal arrivals, pricing, market segments, and guest behavior.
The repository documents a Jupyter Notebook analysis of the Hotel Booking
Demand dataset. It covers data cleaning, duplicate handling, feature
creation, 14 visualization sections, findings, and business recommendations.
The README records 119,390 original rows and 87,396 rows after duplicate
removal.
Built with Python · Pandas · NumPy · Matplotlib · Seaborn · Jupyter
[Visit](https://github.com/devanshudwivedi619/hotel-booking-demand-analysis)
